messages:
emily (People Ops): Quick announcement: review cycle timeline finalized. Key dates: self-assessments due 2026-04-02 23:59 PT, peer feedback window closes 2026-04-05 17:00 PT, manager submissions due 2026-04-12 17:00 PT. Calibration week is 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-19. Please read the short FAQ before your slot.

ryan (Eng Manager): Thanks Emily. Is there a recommended length for manager comments? Want to avoid essays but also be specific.

emily (People Ops): Recommend 4-6 sentences for rating rationale + 1 bullet each for impact and growth. Use the "Manager Packet" template on Drive (file name: Manager Packet — ReviewCycle 2026). There's a one-paragraph example for each band.

priya (Hiring Ops): Heads-up for managers running hiring interviews during calibration week: please reserve at least one calibration-friendly slot per week or flag your reps for asynchronous review. Sync with your TPMs.

review-bot: Reminder sent to managers: "Submit manager writeups by 2026-04-12 17:00 PT" (sent 2026-03-28 09:00 PT).

dave (Software Engineer): Quick Q: peers asked to submit feedback privately or can leads summarize? Some of my cross-team folks want to route through me.

emily (People Ops): Peers should submit via the feedback form (anonymous option available). If partner leads want to send private notes, attach them as "partner corroboration" in the manager packet. Do not copy feedback into public channels.

ryan (Eng Manager): For calibration, are we doing separate comp calibration or combined with performance?

emily (People Ops): Two-stage process: performance calibration first (rubric + evidence), compensation calibration follows the next week. Compensation team will circulate budgets and guidance after performance buckets are locked.

priya (Hiring Ops): Also: hiring ops will freeze external offer approvals during the main calibration days (2026-04-16 to 2026-04-18) to reduce noise on bandwidth. Plan interview loops accordingly.

dave (Software Engineer): Any changes to appeals or dispute window this cycle?

emily (People Ops): Appeals window stays 7 business days after release. New this year: a documented exception flow for time-zone constraints — managers can request a 48-hour extension for APAC reviewers via the form. Use subject line: "Review Extension Request - <team>".

review-bot: Uploaded: "Calibration Rubric v4.pdf" to People Ops folder.

ryan (Eng Manager): Cool. Can People Ops run a short 20-min manager norming session focused on band examples? I can do team-level practice too.

emily (People Ops): Yes — two norming sessions on 2026-04-06 (08:30 PT) and 2026-04-07 (16:00 PT). Links and recordings will be posted. If you can't attend, review the 10-minute microtraining.

priya (Hiring Ops): One operational note: for ICs with cross-functional time on product or infra, please include a partner validation line in the manager packet. It helps during cross-team calibrations.

dave (Software Engineer): Appreciate the clarity. Last ask: will managers get a checklist to confirm forms, examples, and peer feedback are attached?

emily (People Ops): Yes — the submission form enforces 3 checks: (1) rating rationale present, (2) at least one impact example, (3) peer feedback attached or noted. If any are missing you'll get a form validation error. DM me for special cases.

emily (People Ops): Final reminder: be succinct, evidence-first, and avoid last-week recency bias. We're aiming for consistent, actionable reviews. Thanks all :sparkles:
